notes: One string literal changes: ERROR_MESSAGES.UPSTREAM_ERROR in app/api/cartoonify/route.ts. No new error code, no new dependency, no UI change, no lib/env.ts change, no test runner.

Proposed wording: 'Karikatür servisi bu isteği işleyemedi. Sorunun nedeni bilinmiyor; aynı isteği tekrar denemek sonucu değiştirmeyebilir.' The operator approves it at the plan gate; criterion 5 quotes it exactly, so wording and criterion cannot drift apart.

The §3 argument reaches this path more strongly than the unreachable path it was written about: UPSTREAM_ERROR means the provider answered and refused, so re-sending an identical request invites the same refusal. UPSTREAM_UNREACHABLE keeps its hedged retry because transience is genuinely possible there.

SUPERSESSION: this task falsifies task 0002 criterion 12's final `keep` assertion, which pinned the old UPSTREAM_ERROR string. Re-running 0002 criterion 12 against the post-0003 tree will fail by design and is no longer a valid check of that tree. The rest of criterion 12 (the UPSTREAM_UNREACHABLE wording and the bans on 'Bağlantınızı' and 'kontrol') survives and is carried forward by criterion 5.

Task 0001 is NOT superseded. Contrary to the brief's premise, no 0001 criterion pins the UPSTREAM_ERROR string; criterion 20 pins the MISSING_API_KEY text instead. 0001 §5.2 is a contract, not a criterion, and the new wording satisfies it. Criteria 16, 18 and 24 constrain the string only indirectly and all survive.

Criteria 4 and 5 are DISCRIMINATING - both demonstrated failing against HEAD 0ffea3f before any build, with transcripts in §7.2. Criterion 5 was additionally proven to pass against a corrected copy (§7.3), so it discriminates rather than merely being red. Criteria 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 are regression pins, all passing today.

Every command in the mavci-criteria block was executed as written through a JSON parse and a shell before submission, per finding 17. That found three defects in the criteria themselves: invalid JSON in a nested node -e, a BRE '*' that stopped a grep matching (fixed with -F), and a '\n' escape that collapsed into a JS syntax error (fixed with String.fromCharCode(10)).
No criterion contacts the real provider or spends credit; all ten need only the repository, node, git and npm.
No criterion depends on npm run lint, which cannot pass in this project (system finding 5; task 0001 criterion 4 waived under docs/adr/0003-criterion-4-waived.md).

MISSING_API_KEY keeps its imperative deliberately. The argument only partly reaches it - there the cause is known and persistent until a human acts - and it is governed by .mavci/decisions/0002-missing-api-key-is-a-product-state.md. Recommended as a separate task.
title: UPSTREAM_ERROR message stops instructing a retry
